title: No four-label edge coloring of K5 distinguishes all triangles by color sets
scope: Every map E(K5)->Fin 4 has two distinct triangles with equal edge-color sets; refutes Pilsniak-Wozniak arXiv:2407.19050v1 Conjecture 5 (tau_s(n)=n-1 for all n>=4) at n=5. Multiset Conjecture 4 untouched.
source_targets: MathDB 364095 The set-palette conjecture for complete graphs
substantive_reason: Refutes a named universal conjecture at an admissible interior order; source theorems (proper-coloring Theorem 1, multiset lower bound Theorem 3) do not yield the obstruction; counting alone (14 set palettes > 10 triangles) cannot.
